name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd
title: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd - 543663 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 collections recovered (slippage 1.9%→0.7%, UCCE 98.1%) but credit cost guided up to 1.7–1.75% for FY27 and 1.5–1.6% steady state; FY27 AUM growth ~20% on disbursement push of INR6,500–7,000 cr.

triggers.label: Slippage ratio 1.9% → 0.7%
triggers.quote: Our slippage ratio has dropped from 1.9% in the last quarter to 0.7% in this quarter

triggers.label: Credit cost guided 1.7–1.75% FY27
triggers.quote: we will probably be guiding you for a credit cost of 1.7% to 1.75% for the next financial year

triggers.label: Disbursements +24% QoQ to INR1,213 cr
triggers.quote: Our disbursement for the quarter came in at INR1,213 crores, an increase of 24% over the previous quarter

triggers.label: Book yield to fall 30–40 bps more
triggers.quote: I would probably say about 30 - 40 basis points of further impact that may come in over the next three to four quarters

guidance.value: Not expected to fall much; borrowing near 8.5%

evasions.topic: Growth in cost of funds beyond FY27
evasions.quote: we don't expect too much benefit to come in from the cost of funds in the next financial year

red_flags.label: Credit cost guided up from ~1.3–1.35% to 1.5–1.6%
red_flags.quote: we will probably be operating at slightly elevated credit costs than what we have been handling

red_flags.label: Senior management exit during year
red_flags.quote: There was a senior management exit during this year

red_flags.label: GNPA rising for several quarters; NPA 3.37%
red_flags.quote: This has helped our NPA remain largely stable between quarters at 3.37%

red_flags.label: Opex/AUM not falling despite 20% growth
red_flags.quote: it will largely remain around the 7% to 7.25% levels , and not show any big decline during the year
